t: A republic founded in 1806 in southern and western Haiti, ruled from Port-au-Prince by Alexandre Pétion and Jean-Pierre Boyer.
Pétion broke up plantations into peasant smallholdings and armed Simón Bolívar on condition that he free the slaves.
Boyer reunited Haiti, ruled all of Hispaniola from 1822 to 1844 and accepted a crushing French indemnity in 1825.
dyk: When Pétion armed Simón Bolívar in 1816, the payment he asked was that Bolívar abolish slavery in the lands he freed from Spain.
ev: Jacques I is assassinated and a republican constitution is adopted
Alexandre Pétion is elected president as Haiti splits between republic and north
Pétion aids Simón Bolívar and becomes president for life
Boyer reunites Haiti after Henri Christophe’s suicide
Haiti occupies Santo Domingo, ruling all of Hispaniola
France recognises Haiti in return for an indemnity of 150 million francs
